# CANDIDATE: OPENING_RANGE_VWAP_PULLBACK_LONG

**Filed:** 2026-07-09  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

After the opening range establishes an imbalance, a pullback to VWAP with renewed buying pressure offers a high‑probability long entry. This edge exists because institutional algorithms often defend VWAP as a fair value reference, and volume‑confirmed reclaims indicate residual buying pressure after initial OR breakout exhaustion.

## Mechanism

Compute the 15‑minute opening range (ORH, ORL) from 09:30‑09:45 ET. If price closes outside the OR by >0.5% (either above ORH or below ORL) and then, within the next 5 minutes (09:50‑09:55 ET), closes above VWAP with a bullish close (close > open) and volume >1.5× the 20‑period average volume, go long at the close of that bar. Initial stop placed at OR low (for longs) or most recent swing low if OR low is breached intraday. TP1 at 1×R (risk = entry - stop). Runner trailed by a 15% chandelier exit from the highest high since entry. Regime filters: VIX <20, time 09:45‑10:30 ET, EMA8 > EMA21 > EMA55 on 5‑min chart.
